notes.title: Step into the madness... Lovecraftian Days are here
notes.content:
We greet you, fans of Lovecraft's world,

[h3]Today the madness begins. [b]Lovecraftian Days[/b] are taking over Steam and this is an invitation for you to be a part of it.[/h3]

This event hosted by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/]Fulqrum Publishing[/url] brings you a collection of many Lovecraftian games that you can get with sizable discounts. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/sale/Lovecraftian_Days_2023]Take a look at the whole list of participating games by clicking this link[/url].

[b]Necrovision[/b] is, of course, also included! You can get the game for [b]85 % off[/b]. And if you purchase it in a bundle, the discount applies there as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5161/Zombie_TriplePack/


[h3]And to celebrate this important moment, we have some special news to share with all the Lovecraftian fans.[/h3]

First of all, today we are launching [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409200/HYPERVIOLENT/][b]HYPERVIOLENT[/b][/url], an atmospheric horror retro-FPS, into Early Access. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1409200/view/3708192458217527573]Follow the link to read about all the details[/url].

We are also hugely stoked to announce, that the successful Lovecraftian retro-FPS [b]Forgive Me Father[/b] will get a successor. [url=https://twitter.com/ByteBarrel][b]Byte Barrel[/b][/url] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing/]Fulqrum Publishing[/url][/b] are joining forces again to bring you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2/?beta=1][b]Forgive Me Father 2[/b][/url]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2

That's it for today! Now go and enjoy your favorite Lovecraftian games!
